title: おたよりの見出し飾り
lead: おたよりやお知らせの見出しを飾るリボン・看板・雲形などの枠12点です。中があいているので、題名を重ねて使えます。
subject_en: Decorative frames/borders with an EMPTY centre filled with plain white so it becomes transparent; each frame is ONE separate piece centred in its cell, wide landscape, thick enough to hold text or a photo. Title banners for a newsletter heading, cute Japanese mascot style. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
